# Aster Vale Travel Approval Policy

## 4.2 Approval Rule

Employees may claim travel expenses only for approved business travel.

The ordinary approval limit is ₹25,000 with manager approval.

Emergency travel may be submitted retroactively within two business days under Section 7.1.

Authority above the ordinary limit is defined by Authority Matrix v2, Section 2.1.

## 7.1 Emergency Exception

For a declared emergency, a trip may begin without prior approval. The employee must submit the claim within two business days and obtain Division Director ratification.
